name: aria-hallucination
description: Evaluates whether ARIA's outputs contain plausible-sounding but fabricated information.

numerical.label: Very Good
numerical.definition: Zero hallucinations — all content traceable to tools or established context.

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: No factual hallucinations; only minor stylistic elaboration.

numerical.label: OK
numerical.definition: One low-risk hallucination such as slightly wrong opening hours.

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Significant hallucination — invented financial data or product details.

numerical.label: Very Poor
numerical.definition: Dangerous hallucinations — fabricated balances, regulatory rules, or account data.
